premises.text: Video creators struggle to find fitting music: stock libraries are slow to search, expensive, royalty-confusing, require manual editing, and make videos less unique
Patent-pending AI composes original music from scratch using music-theory rules and produces it to a professional standard
premises.evidence_span: patent-pending software that writes original music completely on its own

premises.text: The system delivers unlimited unique tracks that are royalty-free, length/style-customizable, and much cheaper than stock alternatives
premises.evidence_span: unlimited amount of unique music in a variety of styles that's completely royalty-free, instantly customizable, and far cheaper than the alternatives

premises.text: Users pay at download with a free monthly allotment then a per-track fee about 80% cheaper than alternatives
premises.evidence_span: Users pay at point of download

premises.text: Longer-term licensing of the composition technology to platforms that supply music to their users
premises.evidence_span: we'll also license our technology to companies that themselves want to provide music to their users

value.text: Video creators get unique, fitting, affordable soundtrack music on demand
value.evidence_span: create an unlimited amount of unique music

causal_links.evidence_span: Take Marcianophone's pain and multiply it by the millions of other video creators
This is about 80% cheaper than what you'd pay elsewhere
